messages:
maya: pushing release notes for 1.12.0 but deploybot reported publish failed due to provenance build_id mismatch.
samir: saw the same, deploybot logs show built manifest build_id=ci-202803 but provenance attestation=ci-202804 :thinking:
elena: hold the rollout, we shouldn't retag without root cause. what's the delta between the two build ids?
maya: CI re-run created a different artifact because of a flaky apt update step, but image layers identical AFAICT.
deploybot: system: publish rejected: provenance.attestation.build_id != image.labels.build_id (ci-202804 != ci-202803) -> reject. logs: https://ci.internal/1234
samir: if layers are identical, we can pin to the digest that passed attestation in staging. but need approval from security.
ops-sre: security ok with manual override iff we record audit + change window. propose pin to digest sha256:abcd1234 and delay production promotion until Friday 10:00UTC.
maya: agree. I'll update release notes and create a pinned-promote playbook.
elena: also add a postmortem task to fix reproducible build steps (apt caching + lockfile)
maya: quick commands I ran to confirm digests:
```
# list manifest
skopeo inspect docker://111111.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/api:staging
# pull by digest
docker pull 111111.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/api@sha256:abcd1234
```
samir: I'll open an eng-infra ticket to add a hard fail in CI if build_id label is missing/mismatched.
maya: thanks. tagging note: don't retag imgs in place. we'll create a new tag pinned-2026-03-20 that points to digest and update deploybot mapping.
deploybot: ack: scheduled manual publish to prod at 2026-03-20T10:00:00Z with pinned digest sha256:abcd1234, operator: maya
ops-sre: leaving a :thumbsup: reaction, and will broadcast change window in #announcements
maya: done — release notes updated, changelog entry references pin and rollback plan.
samir: follow-up: after promotion we'll rotate cosign key for that pipeline as precaution.
elena: closing loop: everyone ok with the plan? :+1:
maya: +1
samir: +1
ops-sre: +1
